# Third-party code

Copied from npm without change.

| File | Library | License |
|---|---|---|
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css`, `xterm-addon-fit.js` | [xterm.js](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) | MIT |
| `marked.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) 18.1.0 (`lib/marked.umd.js`) | MIT, `LICENSE-marked` |
| `purify.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) 3.4.16 (`dist/purify.min.js`) | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0, `LICENSE-dompurify` |

`ui/ia-chat.js` and `src-tauri/src/chat.rs` are adapted from
[claude-chat-panel](https://github.com/simscorpbs/claude-chat-panel)
(MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 simscorpbs).

`three/` is [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) r186 (MIT,
`three/LICENSE`); what was taken and changed is in `three/README.md`.

## U1 3D model

`ui/printer3d/u1-model.js` and `ui/printer3d/u1-materials.js` (the 3D
printer view) are the parametric three.js model of the Snapmaker U1 made by
kameka22 for Snap Studio, GPL-3.0 like the rest of the app. Not a
third-party component: listed here so its origin is clear.

## Icons

`ui/assets/slice-icons/orca/` (and their copies in the generated
`ui/slice-icons.js`) come from
[Snapmaker/OrcaSlicer](https://github.com/Snapmaker/OrcaSlicer),
`resources/images/`, at `v2.4.0-beta` (b1831e5), the source of the bundled
Snapmaker Orca 2.4.0. License: AGPL-3.0; these files keep their terms
(GPLv3 §13 allows the combination).

`param_rectilinear.svg`, `param_rectilinear-grid.svg`, `param_honeycomb.svg`,
`param_lightning.svg`, `param_hollow.svg`, `param_concentric.svg`,
`param_rectilinear_interlaced.svg`, `param_grid.svg`, `param_support.svg`,
`param_support_tree.svg`; and, in the generated `ui/slice-icons-patterns.js`,
the infill and surface patterns: `param_alignedrectilinear.svg`,
`param_zigzag.svg`, `param_crosszag.svg`, `param_lockedzag.svg`,
`param_line.svg`, `param_triangles.svg`, `param_tri-hexagon.svg`,
`param_cubic.svg`, `param_adaptivecubic.svg`, `param_quartercubic.svg`,
`param_supportcubic.svg`, `param_3dhoneycomb.svg`,
`param_lateral-honeycomb.svg`, `param_lateral-lattice.svg`,
`param_crosshatch.svg`, `param_tpmsd.svg`, `param_tpmsfk.svg`,
`param_gyroid.svg`, `param_hilbertcurve.svg`, `param_archimedeanchords.svg`,
`param_octagramspiral.svg`, `param_monotonic.svg`, `param_monotonicline.svg`.

Changed by `scripts/import-orca-icons.py`: colours replaced by CSS variables,
width and height removed, unused ids and the XML declaration removed,
numbers rounded to 2 decimals, round caps set on
the root, elements sharing a style grouped; the two support icons get a
badge of ours.

`ui/assets/slice-icons/own/` are the app's own drawings, GPL-3.0 like the
rest of Snap Studio.

## Settings catalog

`ui/assets/orca-settings.*.json` (generated by `scripts/gen-orca-settings.py`)
holds labels, tooltips and option names taken from Snapmaker Orca's
`src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp` and its French translation
(`localization/i18n/fr/Snapmaker_Orca_fr.po`). License: AGPL-3.0.
